title: Deletion of stale TypeScript stubs in `core/src/` denied by permission check
what: The stale TypeScript stubs in `core/src/` (`index.ts`, `lock.ts`, `log.ts`, `plan.ts`, `policy.ts`, `protocol.ts`, `store.ts`, `verify.ts`) were not removed. Removal was denied by the permission check during the session.
why: DECISIONS.md D-E2-07 records this: removing them was denied by the permission check, and they are not built. The Goose CLI in `core/src/main.goose` replaces `cli/`.
impact: Stale stubs remain in the tree but are not built. Delete them when permission is granted.
workaround: None — they are not built and do not affect the Goose core.
